palette: muted brown-gray, lighter underside; artistic not known fossil colour
shape_policy: Nasal horn low rounded wedge, laterally thin; paired modest brow bosses; low separated scutes. Short four-digit hands, fourth reduced.
reconstruction_notes: Genus-level Ceratosaurus, shape anchored to MWC 1 in Madsen and Welles 2000 Plate 1; species boundaries not resolved here.
Six metre snout-to-tail Y extent is an artistic adult size, not a specimen measurement.
Muscles, posture, skin palette, iris and conservative horn covering are inferred.
Three major manual digits plus a distinct very reduced fourth nub per hand; palms held inward.
Separate closed anatomical volumes overlap at joints. Color strips on the torso share exact boundaries. Not a fused fabrication-ready solid.
